title: Nutanix Expands Elevate Partner Program to Include System Integrators and Unlock New Revenue Opportunities for Partners
summary:
Nutanix (NASDAQ: NTNX), a hybrid cloud leader and AI platform company , today announced a significant expansion of its FY27 Elevate Partner Program, representing its largest investment in the program to date. The updates bring systems integrators into Elevate, add incentives for referrals, renewals, and customer expansion, and increase support for partner-led services, giving partners more opportunities to generate revenue beyond the initial technology sale.
The expanded program also supports partners looking to grow their businesses around emerging customer requirements, including enterprise AI, cloud-native applications, and databases. Additional incentives are designed to encourage opportunities involving Nutanix Enterprise AI, Nutanix Database Service (NDB), and Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP), alongside the development of services around these technologies.
The inclusion of systems integrators (SIs) in the program recognises their growing role in shaping IT strategy, designing and integrating solutions, managing migrations, and delivering services. Eligible SIs and consulting partners will also be able to earn referral rewards for identifying and developing Nutanix opportunities, even when they are not the partner responsible for the final sale.
The program creates opportunities for eligible partners across seven areas:
Land: Earn rebates on qualifying net-new Nutanix customer transactions.
Expand: Earn applicable rebates by introducing additional Nutanix solutions into existing customer environments, including enterprise AI, cloud-native technologies, and databases.
Grow: Access benefits that recognise qualifying year-over-year business growth.
Reward: Provide incentives to eligible partner sales and technical employees who help identify or secure qualifying new and expansion opportunities.
Retain: Earn incentives for qualifying on-time renewals.
Refer: Earn referral rewards for qualifying opportunities introduced by eligible systems integrators and consulting partners.
Differentiate: Build verified services capabilities through Powered by Nutanix: Verified Services, with eligible partners able to access Earned Business Development Funds for qualifying go-to-market activities.
Incentives, rebates, referral rewards, and business development funding are subject to applicable program requirements, eligibility criteria, and regional availability.
Nutanix is also expanding support for partner-led services through Powered by Nutanix: Verified Services, helping eligible partners build recognised capabilities in areas such as migrations, deployment, and ongoing customer support. Partners will also have access to standardised Service Delivery Kits and opportunities to shadow Nutanix experts, helping them build the technical expertise and delivery capabilities needed to expand their professional services businesses.
"A partner can spend months helping a customer work out what technology they need, plan a migration or prepare for AI, but they don't always get paid for the work that goes into making a sale happen," said Sven Schoenaerts, Vice President, EMEA Channel and Technology Alliances, Nutanix, "We want to change that. Partners should be able to earn money for bringing us new business, helping existing customers do more with Nutanix and providing the services those customers need. That's especially important for systems integrators and consultants, who often do much of the work before a customer is ready to buy."
Nutanix Cloud Platform's flexibility supports expanded partner opportunities, especially as customers contend with hardware availability, infrastructure costs, and the disruption of major technology upgrades. Support for selected external-storage configurations, including applicable Dell, Everpure, and NetApp technologies, gives partners more options to modernise customer environments while retaining existing infrastructure investments. Nutanix Cloud Clusters (NC2) allows partners to help customers run and move supported workloads between on-premises environments and supported public clouds, providing an alternative when hardware availability or capacity becomes a constraint.
Nutanix is also investing in AI-powered tools to simplify partner engagement and identify new opportunities. Deal Coach, planned for introduction through Nutanix Partner Central later this fiscal year, is designed to support sales-cycle activities. Further planned capabilities include approved visibility into selected customer-environment health, adoption, and lifecycle signals, subject to customer authorisation, helping partners better support customers and plan renewals.

content: Nutanix has announced a major expansion of its Elevate Partner Program, including systems integrators for the first time. The updated program adds new incentives for referrals, renewals, and customer expansion, aiming to help partners generate more revenue across emerging areas like enterprise AI, cloud-native applications, and databases. The initiative also introduces AI-powered tools and enhanced support for partner-led services to boost technical expertise and collaboration.

IFX Payments Joins Norwich City as Official Deliverable Foreign Exchange Services Partner
summary:
IFX, the global payments and foreign exchange provider specialising in supporting businesses with complex financial requirements, has today announced it has become the Official Deliverable Foreign Exchange Services Partner of Norwich City Football Club.
The agreement with Norwich City extends IFX’s growing number of partnerships across professional sports, including those already in place with Matchroom, Oxford United, and BOXXER.
From international player transfers to sponsorship revenues, broadcast income and major infrastructure projects, football clubs must regularly navigate complex cross-border financial transactions. In the summer of 2026 alone, EFL Championship teams spent around £300 million on transfer fees, with many clubs conducting transfer business across multiple currencies and jurisdictions.
IFX has extensive experience and deep expertise in supporting businesses, including various professional football clubs, that have financial needs which require more than a traditional banking and payments solution. IFX offers a service-led approach that combines specialist expertise across international payments and foreign exchange, combined with dedicated onboarding and relationship management to support complex operations.
Will Marwick, CEO of IFX Payments, said: “We're proud to begin this partnership with Norwich City. Sports is an industry that has unique payments requirements and highly complex international financial operations. Our deep experience across the sector, from football to boxing to motorsport, means that we inherently understand how to navigate those whilst providing a highly specialist, service-led approach.”
“In the Championship, where the competition is fierce and margins are tight, managing international currency movements effectively and with expert guidance can make a real difference. We are committed to being the partner of choice for sports organisations, and we look forward to supporting the Canaries as they pursue their ambitions on and off the pitch.”
Ed Turnham, commercial director at Norwich City, said: “Partnering with IFX is about more than foreign exchange. It's about aligning ourselves with a business that shares our ambition to modernise, innovate and continually improve how we operate.
“In an increasingly global environment, having the right expertise and support around us is essential and IFX's specialist solutions will help us navigate that with greater confidence and efficiency. This is a transformational partnership for the club and one that supports our wider commercial ambitions.”

content: IFX Payments has been named the Official Deliverable Foreign Exchange Services Partner of Norwich City Football Club. Leadership from both organizations highlighted the partnership's role in modernizing financial efficiency and supporting wider commercial ambitions both on and off the pitch.
